_comment: BOBO KIDS STUDIO — Style Guide. Read by script_generator.py and image_generator.py.

vocabulary: Use concrete nouns (ball, apple, sun) over abstract ones
Avoid metaphors — children this age take language literally
Use present tense primarily ('Bobo finds' not 'Bobo found')
Repeat the key learning word at least 5 times per video
Include the child directly: 'Can YOU see the red apple?'

good: Can you find the red one?
bad: Bobo, overwhelmed by his discovery, gently reached out.
Let us embark on a journey.

story_structure.hook: 0:00–0:15 — Bobo asks the audience a question or shows something surprising
story_structure.intro_song: 0:15–0:35 — Short catchy theme (4-8 bars, same every episode)
story_structure.scene_2: 1:30–2:30 — Explore with a friend (Lumi or Pip joins)
story_structure.scene_3: 2:30–3:30 — Try something, make a small mistake, learn
story_structure.scene_4: 3:30–4:30 — Solve it! Celebrate with a song or chant
story_structure.question: 4:30–4:45 — Ask the child to participate ('Now YOU try!')
story_structure.outro: 4:45–5:00 — Bobo waves goodbye, teases next episode

engagement_hooks: Ask the child a yes/no question every 60-90 seconds
Use child's name placeholder: 'Great job, little explorer!'
Pause 2 seconds after asking a question (let child answer)
Repeat the main lesson word in a sing-song way at the end

forbidden: No sudden loud noises or jump cuts
No scary faces, animals, or creatures
No brand logos or real-world product placement
No imitation of CoComelon, Baby Shark, Bluey, or any existing IP

typography_on_screen.reason: Must be readable on TV from 2m away by a 3-year-old

scene_format.camera: gentle slow zoom (Ken Burns effect) or soft horizontal pan

music_style.bpm_range: 80-110 BPM (not too fast — toddlers can't process rapid tempo)
music_style.instruments: xylophone, glockenspiel, ukulele, soft piano, light percussion
forbidden: Minor keys that sound sad or tense
music_style.source: YouTube Audio Library (primary) or Pixabay (with license proof)

topics_allowed: Animals and the sounds they make
topics_forbidden: Unsafe behaviors (running near roads, playing with fire)
content_rules.one_lesson_per_video: Each video teaches exactly ONE concept. Not 'colors and shapes' — just 'red'.
content_rules.no_near_duplicates: Topic history checked via SQLite DB. Same topic not allowed within 30 videos.

stitch_design_system.note: Used for dashboard UI (Phase 12) and character reference cards.
